    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    people_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    hoodie_patches = image_patch.find("hoodie")
    
    if not people_patches or not hoodie_patches:
        return image_patch

        return person
    
    return hoodie

def execute_command(image):
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    person_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    person_patches.sort(key=lambda person: person.left)  # sort by left coordinate
    far_right_person = person_patches[-1]  # get the patch with the highest left coordinate
    half_height = (far_right_person.upper - far_right_person.lower) / 2
    # crop the patch into two halves
    upper_half = far_right_person.crop(far_right_person.left, far_right_person.lower, far_right_person.right, far_right_person.lower + half_height)
    lower_half = far_right_person.crop(far_right_person.left, far_right_person.lower + half_height, far_right_person.right, far_right_person.upper)
    return [upper_half, lower_half]
